soundness_flags.one_line: For even n and u>=3 ell, the displayed one-batch formula using V^*((u,ell)) equals zero at p_n=1/2, whereas the claimed value 2u^2/3-2ell^2 is positive and arises from the opposite variance orientation (ell,u).

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract and Section 1, lines 3-7 and 35 of the primary arXiv rendering
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper establishes an average-propensity semiparametric lower bound and batched constructions approaching that benchmark, including a sharp second-order rate for linear outcome-mean functionals.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Sections 1 and 5, especially lines 48-54, 205-214, and 299-331 of the primary arXiv rendering
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Zhao studies competitive adaptive Neyman allocation, gives a two-stage square-root-pilot heuristic and fixed-M multistage competitive bounds, and compares them with an information-theoretic limit.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 1, Introduction, lines 50-53 and 84-87 of the proceedings PDF rendering
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The BOLS analysis fixes the total number of batches and lets pulls within each batch grow; it proves BOLS asymptotic normality in that regime.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Repair the one-batch anchor by maximizing over both variance orientations; for even n, retain the u>=3ell branch only with the (ell,u) orientation, then rederive the finite-n minimax count formula.
After repairing the anchor, make the every-B theorem's separation from Zhao and Li theorem-level by stating their distinct loss/classes beside a formal actual-MSE exact-count lower-bound corollary.
Give the uniform-Wald theorem an explicit unit-level martingale variance decomposition and a smallest-cell regime corollary, so its departure from fixed-batch BOLS is independently auditable.

recommended_next_step: Reject this version and correct the contradictory one-batch sanity anchor before any Stage 0 derivation work.
